description: Standard context for flows in Duo Agent Platform. Always sent for every CI-workload flow session.

session_owner_id.description: User id that initiated the flow

service_account_name.description: Username of the service account executing the flow.

primary_branch.description: Branch the workload branch is created from and the flow's changes are diffed against: the triggering branch if it still exists, otherwise the project's default branch. Example: "feature-branch", or "main" when the triggering branch no longer exists.

workload_branch.description: Ephemeral internal ref the flow commits to, branched off primary_branch. Lives under refs/workloads/, not refs/heads/, so it will not show up as a normal branch. Example: "refs/workloads/abcdef12345".
